title: Eddystone Lighthouse
visualBrief: 1882 curved granite sea tower with staggered recessed windows, dark photovoltaic gallery apron, red lantern support cage and modern above-lantern helideck with radial safety net.

sourceFacts.basis: Trinity House current exterior and height; 41 m focal datum is distinct from 49 m structure height. Exact-QID map point and credited photographer views guide viewer placement; operator table coordinate discrepancy remains explicit.

geographicProposal.notes: Mapped viewer anchor is preferred for map alignment; operator table discrepancy remains unresolved and is not silently labelled survey truth. Door/hoist azimuth is a photo-quadrant reconstruction +/-25 degrees. Old Smeaton stump and reef are not part of this single-tower asset. No surveyed footprint, exact landing orientation, present tide or submerged foundation is claimed. +Y up; +Z entrance/hoist faces reconstructed south-southwest quadrant, approximately 202 degrees true, +/-25 degrees. The circular tower has no main plan axis. Visible modeled base meets the host sea-level review plane. This is a visual datum convention, not surveyed reef elevation, mean-high-water conversion, tide or bathymetry.

limitations: The modeled exterior follows the cited published facts and inspected photographs. Unpublished dimensions and local fittings are explicitly photo-proportioned; no claim of engineering survey accuracy is made.
Portable PBR and shared metric surfaces are provided. Surface weathering, material color under local lighting and fine facade relief require close render review before maximum-detail acceptance.

Current granite tower exterior and modern service deck are included. Old Smeaton stump and surrounding rocks are separate site features and are not included in this asset. Intermediate radii, glazing, panel subdivisions and helideck members are photo-proportioned.
referenceRights: Original geometry and shared procedural materials. Official photographs are research references only; no reference imagery or third-party mesh is embedded or redistributed.

nativeAxes.origin: Authored main tower center at local base level; attached ensembles are offset from this origin.

appearance.identity: Concave granite sea tower with recessed staggered ports, dark photovoltaic gallery apron, red crossed helideck supports and broad landing disc with radial net.
appearance.epoch: Modern automated exterior following the current operator photograph; no historical tower or operating optics invented.
appearance.master: Original 24268-triangle master retained byte-for-byte; its capped-loft helideck was confirmed complete by downward and upward ray checks.
appearance.browser: Far derivatives keep main silhouette stations, PV apron, red support cage, complete capped helideck and open white landing rim. Street reduces regular subdivisions while preserving genuine recessed ports and all support members. Closeup uses the complete original master.
appearance.exclusions: Surveyed radii/window layout, exact doorway bearing, resolved operator/map coordinate discrepancy, reef morphology, old stump, true sea datum/tide and internal access route.

geometrySource: Original component-authored exterior mesh using cited dimensional evidence and separately described photo/map reconstructions. No downloaded mesh, texture or reference image is embedded.
sourceLicense: Original geometry under the repository license. Cited sources retain their own rights; OSM-derived axes/footprint evidence © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
materialMethod: Shared canonical material graphs with metric UV repeats in extras.molenSurface; portable glTF PBR factors and vertex colors remain. Dark recesses/lantern panels retain local fallback materials.
reviewStatus: Source geometry ready; fallback/shared renders, maximum fidelity and geographic fit require separate review.
importReason: Keep thin gallery rails, lightning conductors, window reveals and small anchors until a measured LOD chain is reviewed.
